metadata_reference_search_scope: Small <=2MiB integration/identity/freeze/comparison/policy/maintenance JSON under reports only; large saved reports and all SQLite contents were not opened. Code-level separation and preserved Store data establish independence, not a claim that every historical text contains no cache path.
protection_rules: Preserve every published analysis *.sqlite3 and WAL/SHM, frozen source, JSON report/evidence/ledger/policy, original benchmark, Markdown report and source script.
Only explicit memo/bytecode directories listed here are candidates; no directory is deleted by this inventory.
Recheck active FDs/maps/cwd and kernel locks immediately before any root-authorized deletion; a point-in-time zero is not a future guarantee.
v13 and planned v14 full-engine publication do not require old CocoIndex memo; do not revise old engine/reuse metadata after clearing memo.
No target code, test, build, runtime probe, credential or environment is accessed for this inventory.
cache_database_distinction: The .sqlite3.cocoindex suffix names a directory whose observed files are LMDB memo data/lock files; the sibling .sqlite3 is the preserved published analysis Store. No database was opened.
